title: Extendable mapping classes of knotted surfaces obtained by rim surgery in $S^4$
summary: Let $Σ_g^0\subset S^4$, $g\ge3$, be the standard unknotted closed oriented surface, and let $a\subsetΣ_g^0$ be an oriented nonseparating curve. For every nontrivial knot $J\subset S^3$, let $Σ_{g,a,J}\subset S^4$ be the surface obtained from $Σ_g^0$ by ordinary untwisted rim surgery along $a$. We compute its extendable mapping-class subgroup exactly: $$ E(Σ_{g,a,J}) = \operatorname{Stab}_{\operatorname{Mod}(Σ_g)}(q_0) \cap \operatorname{Stab}_{\operatorname{Mod}(Σ_g)} (Γ_μ(J)\cdot[a]). $$ Here $q_0$ is the Rokhlin quadratic form of the standard embedding, $[a]\in H_1(Σ_g;\mathbb{Z})$ is the…
